clinic.name: Mounds View Family Dental
clinic.address: 2436 Mounds View Blvd. STE 110, Mounds View, MN 55112
clinic.heroSubtitle: Experience personalized dentistry for all ages in a family-owned environment. We utilize same-day CEREC crowns and advanced laser technology to keep your smile healthy and confident.

differentiators.title: Family Owned and Operated
differentiators.description: We are free from corporate restrictions, allowing our team to focus entirely on personalized care and building genuine patient relationships.

differentiators.title: Cutting-Edge Technology
differentiators.description: Our office invests in advanced tools like iTero digital scanners and Diagnodent early cavity detection for superior clinical outcomes.

differentiators.title: In-House Specialists
differentiators.description: With doctors trained in periodontal surgery, orthodontics, and dental implants, we minimize the need for external referrals.

differentiators.title: Commitment to Education
differentiators.description: Our clinicians hold prestigious fellowships and stay at the forefront of dentistry through continuous research and advanced clinical training.

treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Initial Exam
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough evaluation using 3D X-rays and digital scans to assess your unique oral health needs.

treatmentJourney.title: Personalized Care Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Dr. Sharara and his team customize a care plan that addresses your specific goals, ensuring you are well-informed about every option.

treatmentJourney.title: Preventive Education
treatmentJourney.description: We empower you with the knowledge and hygiene habits necessary to take control of your daily oral health and prevent future issues.

treatmentJourney.title: Advanced Treatment Delivery
treatmentJourney.description: Utilizing CEREC same-day restorations and laser dentistry, we provide efficient, minimally invasive repairs for decay or damage.

treatmentJourney.title: Cosmetic Refinement
treatmentJourney.description: Enhance your smile's aesthetics with options like Invisalign clear aligners or whitening to boost your self-confidence.

treatmentJourney.title: Long-Term Wellness Care
treatmentJourney.description: Regular follow-ups and periodontal maintenance ensure your smile stays healthy and beautiful for years to come.

benefits.title: Same-Day Restorations
benefits.description: Save valuable time with advanced CEREC technology that allows for high-quality dental crowns to be designed and placed in just one visit.

benefits.title: Advanced Laser Dentistry
benefits.description: Experience precise and minimally invasive treatments with the Fotona dental laser, enhancing your comfort and recovery during procedures.

benefits.title: Family Savings Plan
benefits.description: Access affordable care without dental insurance through our in-office savings program, offering significant discounts on all office fees.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Care
benefits.description: From essential preventive checkups to complex reconstructive surgery, our team meets all your oral health needs under one roof.

benefits.title: Continuity of Care
benefits.description: As a family-owned practice, we prioritize building lasting relationships so you see the same friendly, trusted faces at every appointment.

benefits.title: Multilingual Support
benefits.description: Our staff is proud to support and advocate for the Latino community with team members fluent in both English and Spanish.

implantOptions.title: Dental Implants
implantOptions.description: Replace missing teeth with permanent, natural-looking solutions that restore your ability to eat, speak, and smile with confidence.

implantOptions.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
implantOptions.description: Transform your appearance through Invisalign clear aligners, professional whitening, and esthetic cases designed for a beautiful smile.

implantOptions.title: Restorative Care
implantOptions.description: Repair damage and decay with same-day crowns, laser-assisted root canals, and advanced periodontal treatments to save your natural teeth.

implantOptions.title: Pediatric Dentistry
implantOptions.description: Build a foundation for lifelong health with gentle cleanings, sealants, and education tailored specifically for children's unique needs.

faqItems.question: What if I don't have dental insurance?
faqItems.answer: We offer an In-Office Dental Savings Plan for individuals and families, providing an annual membership that includes a 15% discount on our normal office fees.

faqItems.question: Can I get a crown in a single visit?
faqItems.answer: Yes, using our state-of-the-art CEREC technology, we can create and place high-quality, permanent dental restorations in just one appointment.

faqItems.question: Are you accepting new patients?
faqItems.answer: We are always welcoming new patients of all ages, from a child's very first dental visit to seniors looking to maintain their oral health.

faqItems.question: What technology do you use for exams?
faqItems.answer: We utilize 3D X-rays, iTero intraoral scanners for digital impressions, and Diagnodent laser technology for early hidden cavity detection.

faqItems.question: Do you offer sedation for anxious patients?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we provide sedation dentistry and have sedation-certified assistants to ensure your treatment is as comfortable and stress-free as possible.

faqItems.question: What are your office hours?
faqItems.answer: We are open Monday through Thursday from 7am to 5pm, and Friday from 7am to 1pm to accommodate your busy schedule.

clinic.footerAbout: Mounds View Family Dental is a family-owned practice dedicated to providing professional, technology-driven care to the Mounds View community and surrounding areas since 2000.

doctor.name: Sabry Sharara
doctor.bio: With clinical experience since 2000, Dr. Sabry Sharara is committed to providing top-quality care through advanced technology. He holds fellowship status with the International Congress of Oral Implantologists and the Academy of Gp Orthodontics. Dr. Sharara enjoys all aspects of dentistry, from general care to complex reconstructive and cosmetic procedures. His primary goal is to build trusted relationships by providing personalized, comfortable, and outstanding care.

reviews.name: David R.
reviews.text: I really appreciate that this is a family-owned office. You see the same friendly faces every time, and they truly take the time to explain everything using their digital scanners.

reviews.name: Elena M.
reviews.text: The savings plan is a lifesaver since I don't have insurance. Dr. Sharara and his staff were so gentle, and getting my crown done in just one visit was incredibly convenient.

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Excellent care and very modern technology. I felt comfortable the whole time, and the team really cares about patient comfort and education. Highly recommend for the whole family!
